description: One scripted turn that every agent's tests replay (mcpagent, pydantic and vercel):
the stand-in model asks for these tool calls in one response, the real tools run,
and each call must end as expected.
outcome ok: the result contains output;
outcome error: the model is told of the failure, which contains output.
Change a call here and all three agents are tested on it.

arguments.command: echo scenario check | tr a-z A-Z

calls.output: # Change code and open a pull request
